name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.8: honest handling of machines that do not report temperature. The fridge app has never sent telemetry, so the panel claiming the kiosk reports every five minutes on cooling-capable machines was misleading — it read as missing data rather than a capability that was never built. The panel now distinguishes three states via a per-machine tempReporting setting: unsupported (the board exposes no cabinet temperature, nothing will ever arrive), expected (reporting is enabled, awaiting the first reading), and the default, which states plainly that this machines app does not send telemetry. The cooling-fault complaint email likewise says why no reading is present and tells the operator to check on site, rather than showing an empty temperature block on a food-safety alert. Cumulative over v6.7.
